name: BlueVenture Group Public Company Limited
summary: BlueVenture Group Public Company Limited specializes in providing comprehensive software solutions designed for the motor vehicle claims industry. Their innovative offerings integrate artificial intelligence, featuring "AI Review" for automated claims processing and "AI Estimating" to facilitate visual damage assessment, thereby expediting claim resolution. The company's suite for claims notification includes "M-Survey," a versatile web and mobile platform; "e-Survey," developed to assist field surveyors in collecting vital information at accident sites; and "CarMate," a mobile application catering to various vehicle-related services. For managing claim settlements, their systems encompass "e-Claim," an automated platform for repair claims; "e-Part," an efficient solution for auto parts ordering and inventory management; and "e-Auction," a system for vehicle sales. Additionally, BlueVenture Group supports automotive repair shops with dedicated management tools such as "e-Catalogue," which assists garages in sourcing parts and labor pricing for accurate repair estimates; "e-Garage," a full-fledged garage management system; and "m-Service," a mobile application specifically for service providers. Further enhancements like video call functionality, photo guidance, and business intelligence dashboards are also available. Established in Bangkok, Thailand, in 2000, the company was formerly known as EMCS Thai Co., Ltd. before adopting the BlueVenture Group Public Company Limited name in July 2022. It operates as a subsidiary of Thai Reinsurance Public Company Limited.
